original_test_intent: Read chassis power-supply status through Redfish and verify each installed supply's described identity and agreed status fields match the platform specification.
original_method: Discover the target Chassis Power resource, validate the PowerSupplies array and stable PSU identities, then compare inventory, state, health, redundancy and only governed readings against a versioned oracle without changing power state.
manual_activity: Provide the firmware-matched Power/PowerSupplies contract, fitted-slot and supply-identity matrix, expected State/Health/redundancy semantics and policy for dynamic readings, absent supplies and transient conditions.
required_inputs: Fitted PSU slot and stable identity map
safety_requirements: No hardcoded credentials or TLS bypass
Never invoke chassis power, reset, PSU control, power-limit or redundancy configuration actions
Do not remove power feeds or supplies
Bind results to stable slot and member identity
Fail closed on duplicated, missing, stale or wrong-chassis data
agent_execution_scope: Use secret-backed read-only access over verified TLS
Map each PSU to approved slot identity
Compare state, health and redundancy semantics
Evaluate governed readings with units and timestamps
Report missing, extra or transient supplies distinctly
engineer_actions: Provide endpoint/schema and PSU status oracle
Confirm that no power transition or PSU service action is in scope

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The array is relevant, but the command hardcodes the ChassisId, bypasses TLS, loses enclosing redundancy/context fields and provides no expected PSU population or state policy.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Follow the advertised Power URI, securely retain the complete resource and compare each stable PowerSupplies member plus enclosing redundancy fields with the versioned fitted-slot/status oracle.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Power Status read-only scope and 15/10 timing remain; ChassisId, PSU population, state/redundancy oracle and reading tolerances are not inferred.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use stable slot/member identity and evaluate static population/status separately from load-dependent voltage, current and power readings while retaining the enclosing resource context.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces an array dump and unconditional YES with resource discovery, per-PSU identity, redundancy interpretation, an external oracle and explicit no-action controls.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Validates reported PSU inventory and status only; it does not test failover, hot removal, AC-feed loss, power cycling, load capacity or measurement calibration.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Transient load can change readings and redundancy health can depend on fitted population and feed state; serials and topology also require protected evidence handling.

project_override_considerations: If the firmware represents PSU data through individual PowerSupply/Sensor resources or OEM fields, use the approved mapping and retain the standard resource context. Never treat a count match as sufficient when slot identity or redundancy state differs.
expected_evidence: HTTP status and complete redacted response hash
Redundancy status and approved dynamic readings with units/timestamps

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, generic read-only Procedure and specification-match Criteria consistently call for Power Status inspection. Missing endpoint, supply matrix and policy are incomplete rather than contradictory.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The endpoint/schema, PSU population/status oracle and dynamic policy are identifiable package inputs, so the case is REQUIRES rather than irreducibly BLOCKED.

review_improvement: Converts an unauditable PSU array projection into a slot-aware inventory/status comparison that retains redundancy context and cannot drift into power-control testing.
independent_technical_reasoning: PowerSupplies combines relatively stable identity and health with measurements that change under load. Acceptance must bind each member to an expected fitted slot and interpret absent, standby, enabled, degraded and unknown states using the platform contract; a simple array dump cannot do that. Enclosing redundancy information may be lost when only `.PowerSupplies` is retained. Because this row contains no transition or removal procedure, power cycling, feed interruption and PSU servicing are explicitly outside its authorization.
